title: [batch] pm-dispatch SKILL consolidated amendments + compression — eight ruled cards, two serialized PRs (skills seat, round 1)
body:
Sweep/batch card filed by the **skills seat** (#7623, session `session_01ATJiqhFNL82YwV8udPkoqX`). All eight members carry maintainer rulings recorded 2026-08-11 on their own threads. Batch shape confirmed by the maintainer in the seat's 专题讨论 (2026-08-11): scope confirmed 「确认,七张全收」, then 「包括 7498」 (PR #7552 closed, its content folded here), then the compression directive quoted under PR₂ below. **One claim; two serialized PRs, both human-merged** (sweep discipline, #6243 precedent).

## Members (each row = one checklist section in PR₁'s body; ruling text lives on the member's thread)

| member | what lands |
|---|---|
| #7498 | Four-lens analysis block required on every `needs-user-decision` card (step 0 + step 8); Blocked-by-aware batch selection tier; round-brief decision flags. **Reference implementation: closed PR #7552's diff** (branch `claude/issue-7498-decision-four-lens`, head `24934cf8b`) — reuse against current anchors, do not re-derive; keep `check:skill-frame-sync` green exactly as that PR's body explains (the frame stays 3-axis; the block is its card-face serialization) |
| #7548 | Step-7 ACCEPT path fork extends to `.claude/skills/**` + `skills/**` (same three-part terminal state as `docs/adr/**`); Guardrails entry quoting 「所有 skills 的更新和 adr 类似,需要人工审核」 verbatim; skills-seat structural registration (domain table row, roster/vocabulary row for `domain:skills`, one-time-setup label line) |
| #7493 | 发版板 → **three queries** (objectstack + objectui + cloud); `repo:cloud` seat gains `target:*` production (one-producer-per-backlog); repeal the "a hit in cloud is a mislabel signal" clause; step-9 metric = sum of three. Ruling marks it most urgent |
| #7492 | Operational note 1: queue-membership criterion → `added_to_merge_queue` timeline event (branch test kept for batch position only; `auto_merge`-field warning verbatim); success-sequence rule (`removed_from_merge_queue`→`merged` within ~1s = landing, not ejection); fold note 21's empty-receipt prescription into the same reading discipline (tally 3/3; `disable` does not dequeue) |
| #7518 | Five measured lessons (queue-kick signature receipt + single re-queue then steward handoff; empty-receipt second timing shape — read the queue before flipping; opportunistic restart conditions hang on dispatch-time checks in the owning seat post; claim-race loser posts a handoff comment with its readings; lane inventory via field-narrowed `list_issues` whole-lane read, intersect locally) |
| #7553 | Direction 1: one line making the canonical `Claim:` spelling explicit (predicate stays strict); ⛔ no predicate widening |
| #7583 | Seat-post protocol: bounded body template (Scope / Current PM / Inherited state / Hot-file serial queue / Standing commitments / Notes — all current-state); shift narration lives on cards/PRs/round reports; takeover compaction standard step (edit history = archive); script half: report-only oversized-body H-item in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` |
| #7512 | Option (a): explicit clause in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (+ dispatch-brief echo where it verifiably repeats) ranking the dispatch contract above platform-injected PR-subscription postures |

## PR₂ — structural compression (maintainer directive, 2026-08-11, verbatim, untranslated)

> 现在 的 项目经理skills 太长了,需要考虑怎么压缩

Measured composition @ `origin/main` (3027 lines): The round loop 1870 (step 5 Dispatch 587, incl. Prompt template 326; step 7 Review 380; step 0 sweep 200; step 6 Collect 195; 入队与落地 167; step 8 130), Operational notes 612, Domain lanes 209, State model 111, the rest 189. Existing extraction targets: `references/incidents.md` (140 lines, append-only), `references/compile-surfaces.md` (27).

**Prescription (seat's plan of record; the maintainer vetoes at PR review):**

- Target: main file **~1400–1600 lines** (deep compression, roughly −50%).
- Method: every rule keeps its **imperative + criteria/command + one-line case anchor** (issue number); narratives, 沿革, worked examples, incident retellings move **verbatim** to `references/incidents.md` (append-only, 出处 line each) or a new `references/operational-notes.md`. Machine-consumed tables (domain lanes, 词表, roster, label setup) stay in the main file.
- ⛔ **No rule deletion** — compression moves prose, never removes a binding rule, criterion, or prohibition; deleting a rule requires its own maintainer ruling.
- Ratchet: lower `check:pm-skill-ratchet`'s ceiling from 3050 to the achieved count (shrink-only lock-in).
- `check:skill-frame-sync` stays green; the four frame copies are untouched by moves.

## Delivery order (load-bearing, #7341 precedent: pure moves come AFTER all textual additions)

1. **PR₁ — amendments**: the eight member sections above. `Fixes #7498, #7548, #7493, #7492, #7518, #7553, #7583, #7512` + `Part of #7631`. Ratchet: 3027/3050 today — pay any overage by minimal extraction.
2. **PR₂ — compression**: opened only after PR₁ is merged (same file, strict serialization). Pure structural moves + ratchet lowering. `Part of #7631`; this card closes after PR₂ lands.
3. Both PRs are **ADR-class**: draft/review by AI seats, then visibly pending; ⛔ nobody merges, enqueues, or arms auto-merge — **the maintainer merges manually**.

## Constraints

- File surface: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, `scripts/` ratchet config (+ published `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/**` only if the dispatch-brief echo verifiably repeats there). ⛔ No `docs/adr/**`. Zero changes beyond the checklist (`git diff --stat` matches 1:1 per PR).
- PR #7552 is **closed** (maintainer instruction, provenance on its thread) — no in-flight SKILL.md PR remains; this batch is dispatchable now.
- `skip-changeset` label (`.claude/` + `scripts/` only; #5471 rejects empty changesets). English on GitHub. Sanitizer discipline on every write (HTML entities for literal angle brackets; read back and verify).
- Dispatch tier: **`model: claude-fable-5` mandatory** (SKILL surface, maintainer 2026-08-10), `mode:cloud`.

## Member candidacy

Per sweep rule 5: members keep `pm:queue` but are **not** individual dispatch candidates while this card is open; they close together via PR₁'s `Fixes` lines.
